newsitem.title: USA: Realty World creditors file Chap 11 petition.
newsitem.headline: Realty World creditors file Chap 11 petition.

text.p: The creditors committee for Realty World Holding Corp said Thursday that it has filed a Chapter 11 reorganization petition in the Federal Court for the District of Nevada.

The committee said that the petition related only to the parent holding corporation, not to its principal subsidiary, Realty World Corp, an international real estate franchising and real estate broker netowrk with about 450 real estate offices.
The committee added that the creditors are seeking purchasers for the holding corporation.
